description: The plot titled “ChatGPT on Movies” illustrates how three metrics—Accuracy, Confidence, and Alignment—vary across increasing x-axis values. The x-axis is unlabeled, uses a linear scale, and spans approximately 15 to 55 with labeled ticks at 15, 20, 25, 30, 35, 40, 45, 50, and 55 (5-unit intervals). The y-axis is labeled “Values,” uses a linear scale, and ranges from 0.86 to 1.00 with labeled ticks every 0.02. Three lines are shown: Accuracy is a blue solid line with circular markers, starting near 0.895 at x=15, dipping around 0.900 at x=17 after rising to about 0.922 at x=16, then increasing to about 0.933 at x=19 and about 0.962 at x=21, followed by a small decrease to about 0.960 at x=24 and then a steady rise to about 0.972 at x=31, about 0.981 at x=38, and about 0.986 at x=55. Confidence is a green solid line with upward triangle markers, beginning around 0.977 at x=15, staying near 0.978–0.979 at x=16–18, rising to about 0.987 at x=20 and about 0.991–0.992 at x=22–27, reaching about 0.995 at x=31, remaining around 0.994 at x=38, and ending near 0.997 at x=55. Alignment is a red solid line with square markers, starting around 0.918 at x=15, rising to about 0.942 at x=16, dropping to about 0.922 at x=17, increasing to about 0.943 at x=19 and about 0.972 at x=21, slightly decreasing to about 0.969 at x=24, then increasing to about 0.976 at x=31, about 0.987 at x=38, and ending near 0.990 at x=55.
